title: Enchanted Conversation Archive
hero_prompt: A wide sumi-e ink-wash scroll painting of one ancient tree whose roots fork into a river delta below the earth-line, loose black brushstrokes on aged paper, small lantern-like marks glowing faintly at each fork where a root splits. The single dominant image is the branching, rooted forest of forks itself, evoking an archive that keeps every path rather than one trunk. Hand-made sumi-e ink-wash scroll, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold black ink-wash silhouette of one root forking into three branches against a pale ground, thick confident brushstrokes, no fine linework, reading clearly as a single emblem at small size.
